purpose: Permanent playbook for the recurring Waydroid problems on this machine (session dies, container FROZEN, adb dead, run-as broken). Community-checked + locally verified. Never re-diagnose from scratch.

1_session_lives_only_with_its_starter.symptom: waydroid session start prints 'Android with user 0 is ready', returns to prompt, and the session STOPPED again within seconds when run in a normal foreground command/chain
1_session_lives_only_with_its_starter.community_status: waydroid has no systemd session unit; session lifetime is tied to the starting process (no upstream launcher found; searches for session/systemd returned no official unit)
1_session_lives_only_with_its_starter.permanent_fix_verified: START DETACHED - nohup waydroid session start >/tmp/waydroid-session.log 2>&1 &   (developer-verified 2026-11-18; kept RUNNING through the whole v1.0.11 device test)
1_session_lives_only_with_its_starter.boot_permanence: OPTIONAL (needs your approval, writes outside the project): ~/.config/systemd/user/waydroid-session.service with ExecStart=/usr/bin/waydroid session start, then systemctl --user enable --now waydroid-session - survives login
1_session_lives_only_with_its_starter.never: do not run session start inside a command chain or a terminal you close

2_container_frozen_adb_hangs.symptom: waydroid status shows Session: RUNNING, Container: FROZEN; adb commands hang or time out
community: waydroid/waydroid#2256 'Blackscreen & FROZEN state' (closed per-machine, no universal fix)
waydroid/waydroid#2447 'image freezes when its window loses focus' (OPEN - focus/idle triggers freeze)
project precedent: android/device_smoke.sh already wraps itself in systemd-inhibit --what=idle and dismisses lock screens - same root cause
2_container_frozen_adb_hangs.prevention_verified: systemd-inhibit --what=idle --mode=block --why=dkbt-test sleep 1800 &   (developer-run, held the whole v1.0.11 test)
2_container_frozen_adb_hangs.adb_rescue_after_thaw: adb disconnect 192.168.240.112:5555; adb connect 192.168.240.112:5555  (stale transport shows 'device offline')
2_container_frozen_adb_hangs.anti_idle_on_device: adb shell svc power stayon true  (set once per test session)

3_no_route_to_host.symptom: adb connect fails 'No route to host' right after session start
3_no_route_to_host.root_cause_local: race - waydroid-net.sh starts AFTER 'ready' (waydroid log shows net start timestamp)
3_no_route_to_host.fix_verified: wait until ping -c2 192.168.240.112 passes, then adb connect (retry once); L3 was fine 100% of the time after ~5s

4_run_as_broken.symptom: adb shell run-as <pkg> -> 'run-as: setegid(AID_PACKAGE_INFO) failed: Operation not permitted'
4_run_as_broken.community: waydroid/waydroid#1467 - OPEN since waydroid 1.4.2, NO upstream fix (known platform gap)
4_run_as_broken.permanent_workaround_verified: sudo waydroid shell -- sh -c '<command as root Android shell>'   - works for app-private data (used for the v1.0.11 migration backup: tar of /data/data/com.dkbondtracker.app)
4_run_as_broken.adb_root: unavailable on this build (userdebug adbd lacks root) - do not retry

5_release_install_signature.symptom: INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE when installing a release APK over a gradlew debug build
5_release_install_signature.permanent_rule: per RELEASING.md: debug-era installs need migration (export -> uninstall -> install -> restore); headless path = sudo waydroid shell tar backup of /data/data/<pkg> before uninstall (backup-only was developer-approved 2026-11-18)
5_release_install_signature.verify_after: adb shell dumpsys package com.dkbondtracker.app | grep -E 'versionName|versionCode='

pre: adb connect && adb shell svc power stayon true
checks: adb logcat -c; adb shell am start -n com.dkbondtracker.app/.MainActivity; sleep ~15 (Chaquopy first boot)
adb shell uiautomator dump -> look for Dashboard text + auto-fetch-consent (fresh install = model-B consent, ILF-12)
adb logcat -d | grep -E 'FATAL|ANR in com.dkbondtracker' -> must be empty
python.stdout 'DKBT serving http://127.0.0.1:5000/' in logcat = backend up
state reset between runs: adb shell pm clear com.dkbondtracker.app (Q8; sudo waydroid shell fallback if shell uid denied)
headless_smoke_recipe.gui_script_note: android/device_smoke.sh is GUI-driven (ydotool/dbus/lock-dismiss) - DO NOT use when the developer's workflow must not be disturbed; use this adb recipe instead
